steps.js: (async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.addLocalRepository(__REPO_PATH__); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); window.__gitgood.store.set({ dialog: { kind: 'settings', tab: 'git' } }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); return JSON.stringify({ dialogKind: window.__gitgood.store.get().dialog && window.__gitgood.store.get().dialog.kind }); })()

(async () => { window.__gitgood.store.set({ dialog: null, dialogStack: [] }); const cur = window.__gitgood.store.get(); window.__gitgood.store.set({ changes: { ...cur.changes, summary: 'Signed commit attempt' } }); await window.__gitgood.actions.commit(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); const after = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ dialogKind: after.dialog ? after.dialog.kind : null, errorCode: after.dialog && after.dialog.error ? after.dialog.error.code : null, committing: after.changes.committing }); })()

(async () => { const onUnsigned = window.__gitgood.store.get().dialog.onUnsigned; window.__gitgood.store.set({ dialog: null, dialogStack: [] }); onUnsigned(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); window.__gitgood.actions.setView('history'); await window.__gitgood.actions.loadHistory(true); const after = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ dialog: after.dialog ? after.dialog.kind : null, historyTop: after.history.commits[0] && after.history.commits[0].summary }); })()
